source.snippet: I am a beginner when it comes to investing, but I would like to get started with investing my money better. Due to my work, I have to move countries frequently and unpredictably (say, every 2-4 years), and it is hard to know where I will 'end up' eventually. However, I don't want hold off on making long-term financial decisions any longer.

problem_statement: Globally mobile professionals (frequent expats, international contractors, diplomats) cannot easily access long-term investment guidance or platforms that account for multi-country tax residency changes, making it hard to invest without risking account closures or tax penalties.
target_segment: Internationally mobile professionals — contractors, expats, digital nomads, NGO/corporate staff — who move countries every 2-4 years and have disposable income to invest.
notes: Question has 3 upvotes and zero answers — a real gap. Segment has money (they're working professionals) and urgency (actively wanting to invest now). Existing robo-advisors and brokerages routinely close accounts when users relocate, creating a repeating pain. Opportunity: a financial advisory service or SaaS tool specialized for nomadic professionals, possibly subscription-based with tax-aware investment guidance per residency change. Recurring need = recurring revenue potential.
